title: Review, join, recover and leave a waiting campaign
description: A developer creates a real waiting campaign, reviews portrait/faction/briefing with a persistent commitment rail, joins and recovers that exact campaign through Play. Waiting membership never offers Continue. Seat release is acknowledged and survives reload. The catalogue seed is fixed by the emulator-only harness; no campaign state or tick is fabricated.

steps.description: Prepare a saved commander identity through ordinary UI and grant explicit emulator developer access. The test loader fixes catalogue entropy only.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open campaign creation and name the four-empire development galaxy.
steps.acknowledgement: The named proposal is ready to commit.
verifications: Create galaxy stays in the viewport before automatic scrolling.

steps.description: Create the galaxy and review its faction choice before claiming a seat.
steps.acknowledgement: Campaign creation is acknowledged and faction selection opens.
verifications: The initial view contains all four choices, affinity matrix and Claim without automatic scrolling; longer reading remains bounded.

steps.description: Review portraits and choose The emissary without leaving the visible seat commitment.
Return to the faction briefing while keeping the chosen portrait and commitment.
verifications: Keyboard-selected Vesper and the complete four-class affinity matrix remain readable; no document scroll or seat claim occurs.

steps.description: Read the campaign briefing and distinguish the shared-victory design from enabled development behavior.
steps.acknowledgement: The briefing explicitly says victory evaluation is not enabled.
verifications: Claim remains visible while reviewing the briefing.

steps.description: Open the actual rules with the keyboard, then read the last faction capacity inside the bounded campaign details. The selected faction and uncommitted seat remain unchanged.
steps.acknowledgement: The real rules disclosure remains open; no seat has been claimed.
verifications: The final faction and capacity are fully readable, with the commitment and document position preserved.

steps.description: Commit the seat and enter the authoritative waiting galaxy.
steps.acknowledgement: The seat is confirmed and the one-member manifest preserves the waiting phase.
verifications: The campaign URL records its authoritative UUID.

steps.description: Return to entry. A waiting membership remains accessible through Play and does not offer Continue.
steps.acknowledgement: Play is available without an active-campaign Continue.
verifications: The campaign directory link is retained.

steps.description: Open and close identity, returning keyboard focus to its entry control.
verifications: The acknowledged navigation causes no uncaught application errors.

steps.description: Use Play to review the joined waiting campaign by name.
steps.acknowledgement: The joined campaign appears in the directory.
verifications: The directory reports exactly one joined membership.

steps.description: Select the named membership and recover its exact authoritative galaxy.
steps.acknowledgement: The same campaign URL, named saved seat and waiting manifest recover.
verifications: The acknowledged navigation causes no uncaught application errors.

steps.description: Reload the waiting galaxy, recover its exact directory card through Campaigns and reopen its roster.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovered roster permits leaving the waiting campaign.
verifications: Reload retains the exact campaign ID.

steps.description: Close the roster with Escape and retain its keyboard opening control.
verifications: The acknowledged navigation causes no uncaught application errors.

steps.description: Reopen the roster with Enter and release the waiting seat.
steps.acknowledgement: Seat release is acknowledged and the member galaxy view closes.
verifications: One logical Leave has its matching accepted receipt; membership is absent and the retained protected view denies player access, with no involuntary-access error or retry remedy.
The ordinary journey has no uncaught page errors.

steps.description: Reload entry and open Play again to confirm the released membership is absent.
steps.acknowledgement: Your campaigns reports zero joined seats.
